about.title: What is Velora?
about.text: Velora: Health Companion is an iPhone app. It reads the Health data already on your iPhone and writes short, plain notes about your steps, water and drinks. Velora Pro adds Coach tips after every workout and AI coach lines on your goals. Free to download, no account needed. General wellness information, not medical advice.
about.notAffiliated: Not affiliated with other products named Velora.

free.a: Velora is free to download. Notes on your steps and water, the Home greeting and step goal suggestions from your own history are free. Velora Pro is optional and adds Coach tips after every workout, AI coach lines on your goals, iCloud backup and extra app icons.

account.a: No. Velora works without an account. Open the app and go.

data.q: Does my Health data leave my iPhone?
data.a: Your Health data is read on your device and never sent to our servers. With Velora Pro, iCloud backup goes to your own iCloud account, not to us.

devices.q: Which iPhones does Coach work on?
devices.a: Velora is an iPhone app. Velora Coach writes with Apple Intelligence, so it needs an iPhone where Apple Intelligence is available and turned on. Notes on your steps and water work without it.

languages.a: Yes. The app and this site are in English and Turkish.

medical.a: No. Velora gives general wellness information, not medical advice. Talk to a doctor about medical questions.
